docs.title: tf_module_build_sa
docs.text: Build a SAP BTP subaccount from scretch

docs.title: Resources
docs.text: Name Type btp_subaccount.subaccount resource btp_subaccount_role_collection_assignment.sa_administrators resource btp_subaccount_role_collection_assignment.sa_viewers resource btp_subaccount_trust_configuration.create_trust resource

docs.title: Inputs
docs.text: Name Description Type Default Required btp_idp FQDN of the Identity Provider (IdP) to be trusted. string n/a yes btp_platform_idp FQDN of the Platform Identity Provider. string n/a yes parent_id Parent ID for the subaccount. string n/a yes project_name Name of the project the subaccount belongs to. string n/a yes stage Stage of the subaccount to be created. string n/a yes subaccount_region Region where the subaccount shall be created in. string n/a yes

docs.title: Outputs
docs.text: Name Description subaccount_id Technical ID of the subaccount. subaccount_name Display name of the subaccount. subaccount_subdomain Subdomain of the subaccount.
